spark: Ilwen brewed the draught that nearly killed her grove's elder, and let her own teacher take the blame and the exile

focal.name: Ilwen
focal.who: A quiet elf herbalist who brews for no one but herself.
focal.backstory: Ilwen brewed a draught meant to make her grove's elder sleep through a council vote, and it nearly killed him. She said nothing when her teacher was blamed and sent into exile.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
